// J1939_CCVS1: CAN ID 0x18FEF100 (extended), 8 bytes, sender ECM, cycle time 100 ms
// J1939 PGN 65265 (0xFEF1) CCVS1 — Cruise Control/Vehicle Speed 1, priority 6, PDU2 (broadcast), source address 0x00
//
// Decode pseudo-code generated by CanViewer from demo.dbc.
// data[0] .. data[7] are the payload bytes; bit 0 is the least significant bit of a byte.
// Shifts and masks work on unsigned integers wide enough for the signal.

// ParkingBrakeSwitch: start bit 2, 2 bits, Intel, unsigned, factor 1, offset 0, range 0 .. 3
ParkingBrakeSwitch_raw = (data[0] >> 2) & 0x03
ParkingBrakeSwitch = ParkingBrakeSwitch_raw

// WheelBasedVehicleSpeed: start bit 8, 16 bits, Intel, unsigned, factor 0.00390625, offset 0, range 0 .. 250.996 km/h
WheelBasedVehicleSpeed_raw = data[1] | (data[2] << 8)
WheelBasedVehicleSpeed = WheelBasedVehicleSpeed_raw * 0.00390625

// CruiseCtrlActive: start bit 24, 2 bits, Intel, unsigned, factor 1, offset 0, range 0 .. 3
CruiseCtrlActive_raw = data[3] & 0x03
CruiseCtrlActive = CruiseCtrlActive_raw
